title: Log in from overseas
summary: This page provides information on how to log into your MyServiceNSW Account when you are located overseas.
intro: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is required for all MyServiceNSW Accounts. It will help keep your account secure.
who_can_apply: Must be attempting to log in from overseas
what_you_need: Access to the online form to contact Service NSW (if calling is not possible)
Knowledge of alternative contact methods if primary MFA methods are unavailable
contact:
If you're in Australia and need help, call us on 13 77 88 or go to a service centre.

If you're overseas and need help, call +61 2 8894 1555 or use the online form to contact us.

more_info.text: Change mobile phone or device used for multi-factor authentication

internal_links.text: set up at least 2 methods of MFA
Change mobile phone or device used for multi-factor authentication

faqs.q: What is required to keep my MyServiceNSW Account secure?
faqs.a: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is required for all MyServiceNSW Accounts.

faqs.q: How can I get help logging in if I am overseas?
faqs.a: You can call +61 2 8894 1555 or use the online form to contact Service NSW.

faqs.q: What should I do if I lose access to my mobile device or MFA methods while overseas?
faqs.a: If you cannot access your Australian mobile number, or your MFA methods (like the Service NSW app, authenticator app, or text message), you should contact Service NSW.
